meta.topic: Used-car listing distributions, test drives, title and registration on purchase, delivery and collection, parking, running out of fuel, service appointments
meta.method: Web search to find sources, then each figure read on the publisher's own page or file where it would load (WebFetch, curl, pdftotext, or the publisher's open-data API). 'confirmed' is true only when the figure was read on the publisher's own page, file or API; otherwise it is false and 'note' says where the figure came from. Several publishers (Carfax, CarMax, Tesla, Edmunds, J.D. Power, LADOT, City of Vancouver web pages, Green P, SEMOVI, ecoParq, ICBC fee pages) refused automated reads (HTTP 403, Incapsula or connection refused); their figures are search-summary or third-party only and marked false. Nothing is estimated. Read alongside research-car-sale.json (seller-side transfer steps, daysToSell, listing fees), research-car-buying.json (averageAnnualMileage for US/CA/IE, average used prices, depreciation, Carfax report prices, destination charges, a short test-drive note), research-garages-reservations-carsale.json (named garages in all eight towns, parking taxes) and research-roadside.json (breakdown call rates, AA Ireland cause shares including fuel 10.5%). Those figures are not repeated here.

usedListingDistributions.metric: Average annual mileage per car by fuel type, 2025
usedListingDistributions.note: DfT National Travel Survey table NTS0901a, read from the ODS file itself (last updated 10 September 2026, NTS 2025). Plug-in hybrid marked [u], too few cases. This supersedes the unconfirmed 2024 UK figure in research-car-buying.json averageAnnualMileage.UK. Trip-purpose split 2025: business 500, commuting 2,200, other private 4,500. Company cars 4% of cars, private 96%.

usedListingDistributions.metric: Distribution of cars by annual mileage band, 2025 (percent of cars)
usedListingDistributions.unit: percent of cars in each annual-miles band
usedListingDistributions.note: DfT NTS0904, read from the ODS. Rounded percentages; they sum to 100. This is a published spread, not just a mean, so a generator can draw a car's yearly miles from it. 2024 row: 2,1,5,7,9,8,23,16,16,6,3,2,1,1.

usedListingDistributions.market: United States (New York, Los Angeles, New Haven)
usedListingDistributions.metric: Annual miles driven by passenger-car age, with survival rate (NHTSA schedule from the 2001 NHTS)
usedListingDistributions.unit: miles per year by vehicle age in years; survivability as fraction still registered
usedListingDistributions.note: NHTSA Technical Report DOT HS 809 952, Tables 5 and 7, read from the PDF on NHTSA's server. Old data (2001 NHTS, 1977-2002 registrations) and higher than today's average: FHWA's 2024 figure is 10,787 miles per light-duty vehicle (research-car-buying.json). The shape by age is what this adds; the level is dated. No newer official US by-age schedule was found.

titleRegistration.unit: USD per transaction (registration fees per 2-year term)
titleRegistration.note: Read on the DMV page. A search summary claimed the title fee drops to $5 from 1 April 2026 under an amendment to VTL §2125; the DMV page read still shows $50, so the $5 claim is unconfirmed. Sales tax on a private sale is collected by DMV at registration (not re-read here). Seller steps are in research-car-sale.json.

Fee table read from the DMV's own Registration Fees page (via its WordPress JSON endpoint, page modified 2026-06-30). The 10-day reporting rule was read on https://www.dmv.ca.gov/portal/vehicle-registration/titles/title-transfers-and-changes/. The page does not say after how many days the $15 transfer penalty starts; secondary sites say 30 days, unconfirmed. Smog certification may be required; use tax on a private sale is not covered here.

Title, registration, plate, clean air, administrative and lien fees read on the DMV fees page (confirmed). The 3-year term for the $120 fee and the 6.35% sales tax rate are from search snippets of portal.ct.gov pages, not read in full. No buyer deadline in days was found.
